title: Inventory and Assortment Optimization under General Choice: A Unified Approximation Framework
abstract: arXiv:2611.05708v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study joint inventory and assortment optimization under general substitutable choice models. Before a selling horizon, a decision maker chooses initial inventories subject to a capacity constraint on total units stocked, and customers then arrive sequentially and choose among the offered products. We consider two settings, show-all inventory selection, in which every in-stock product must be offered, and dynamic assortment personalization, in which the decision maker observes each customer's type and may adapt the offered assortment to remaining inventory and purchase history. We develop a unified framework linking each setting to a static optimization problem. For show-all inventory selection, a polynomial-time $\alpha$-approximation for cardinality-constrained static assortment optimization yields guarantees of $0.486\alpha$ under deterministic or Poisson arrivals and $0.4328\alpha$ under increasing-failure-rate (IFR) arrivals. translated_title: 一般选择模型下的库存与品类组合优化：统一近似框架
translated_abstract: 我们研究一般可替代选择模型下的联合库存与品类组合优化问题。在销售期开始之前，决策者在库存总量的容量约束下选择初始库存，随后顾客依次到达，并在所提供的产品中进行选择。我们考虑两种情形：一是“全展示库存选择”，即所有有库存的产品都必须被展示提供；二是“动态品类个性化”，即决策者可以观察每位顾客的类型，并根据剩余库存和购买历史动态调整所提供的品类组合。我们开发了一个统一框架，将每种情形都与一个静态优化问题联系起来。对于全展示库存选择问题，利用基数约束下静态品类组合优化的多项式时间α-近似算法，可以在确定性或泊松到达情形下获得0.486α的性能保证，在递增失效率（IFR）到达情形下获得0.4328α的性能保证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一近似框架，将一般选择模型下的联合库存与品类组合优化（涵盖全展示库存选择与动态品类个性化两类情形）归结为静态优化问题，并在确定性/泊松到达及IFR到达等情形下获得了多项式时间的近似保证。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a unified approximation framework that reduces joint inventory and assortment optimization under general choice models—covering both show-all inventory selection and dynamic assortment personalization—to static optimization problems, yielding polynomial-time approximation guarantees such as 0.486α under deterministic/Poisson arrivals and 0.4328α under IFR arrivals.
